findings.finding: Software platforms (Gotham, Foundry, Apollo, AIP) sold to government (51% of Q2 2026 revenue, 990M) and commercial (945M) customers; revenue = customers x revenue per customer, with U.S. commercial customers 653 (+35% y/y) and top-20 average TTM revenue 124M (+67% from 75M): growth is mostly deeper spend per existing customer (NDR 157%) plus new logos.

Q2 2026 revenue +93% y/y; U.S. commercial +149% and U.S. government +90% drive it, rest of world only +34%. No acquisitions in the history; growth is organic and structural (AIP adoption, wider government programmes), not a price or cycle effect. Residual (mix of one government cloud-hosting customer) is small and named by management.

No customer above 10% of revenue; top three customers 16% of H1 2026 revenue. Government budgets fund about half; most government contracts are terminable for convenience and options are not committed, so RPO (4.9B, 43% within 12 months) understates and total remaining deal value (13.1B, assumes all options) overstates firm demand. No vendor financing or take-or-pay on the customer side.
Structural: revenue grew every year FY2020-FY2025 (17%-56%) with no down year, margins rose steadily from -107% to +32% operating; nothing in the history shows a cycle.

Confirmed high_growth / fast_grower: revenue compounding above 20% (TTM +79%, latest quarter +93%) and operating margin already 47%; the questions are how long growth lasts and whether margins hold, not survival.

Conservative guider: revenue beat the guided midpoint in all 8 recorded periods, ratio 1.082 (quarterly-only about 1.067, the FY2025 initial guide row 1.19 inflates the mean); FY2026 guide raised from 7.656B to 8.154B (+82% y/y). The guide is a floor, so the track-record ratio is applied to the unreported remainder.

Q2 2026 net income 1,062M includes about 71M after-tax unrealized securities gains (SpaceX holding); normalized about 991M. GAAP tax only 1.4% of pretax (SBC deductions, NOLs) while adjusted EPS uses 23%: GAAP earnings overstate a steady-state after-tax profit. SBC 265M (13.7% of revenue) is a real cost; adjusted operating income (1,194M) excludes it.

GAAP operating margin 47% in Q2 2026 vs 32% FY2025 and a historical median of 5%: a record quarter x 4 is not a normalized run rate; management flagged a significant seasonal expense ramp in Q3. The FY2026 guide implies about 60% adjusted operating margin, about 46% after SBC.

Piotroski 7/8 (strong), Altman Z'' 10.5 (safe), no debt, 9.4B cash and short-term Treasuries; Beneish and ROIC not computed by the prefetch (gap). Invested operating capital is tiny (capex under 1% of revenue), so ROIC is very high and not a constraint.

Diluted shares 2.569B vs basic 2.400B; diluted count +0.2% y/y, so SBC dilution is now largely offset; buybacks are small (75M in FY2025). SBC fell from 24% of revenue (FY2024) to 15% (FY2025) and 13.7% (Q2 2026).
March 2026 cloud-hosting amendment commits at least 5.6B over ten years to 2036 (annual minimums 268M-979M): an operating cost floor if growth stalls. No debt; 500M revolver undrawn.
